ladder.why: Add the entering value, subtract the leaving one: a window of size k slides in O(1) per step.

ladder.teaches: variable window: the longest valid (shrink while invalid)
ladder.why: The classic longest valid window: grow right, and when a repeat appears move left just past its previous occurrence.

ladder.teaches: variable window: the longest valid (shrink while invalid)
ladder.why: Rephrasing 'flip at most k zeros' as 'longest window with at most k zeros' and shrinking only while the window is invalid.

ladder.teaches: window with a frequency map (distinct counts, anagrams)
ladder.why: A fixed window carrying 26 letter counts: only two counts change per slide, and a match means an anagram.

ladder.teaches: variable window: the shortest valid (shrink while valid)
ladder.why: The mirror template: record the length while the window is valid, then shrink to look for something shorter.

ladder.teaches: window with a frequency map (distinct counts, anagrams)
ladder.why: Validity read from the frequency map: window length minus the most frequent count is the number of replacements needed.

ladder.teaches: exactly k = at most k minus at most k-1
ladder.why: Exactly k odd numbers is awkward to slide, at most k is easy (each right end adds right - left + 1), so subtract atMost(k-1) from atMost(k).

ladder.teaches: window maximum with a monotonic deque
ladder.why: Values smaller than a newer value can never be a window maximum again, so a decreasing deque of indices gives every maximum in O(n).

ladder.teaches: variable window: the longest valid (shrink while invalid)
ladder.why: Sorting timestamps turns 'requests within one time window' into the longest window with last - first under a limit.

ladder.teaches: variable window: the longest valid (shrink while invalid)
ladder.why: Amazon OA: sort, then the kept boxes are a contiguous run, so find the longest window with max <= capacity * min.

ladder.teaches: variable window: the longest valid (shrink while invalid)
ladder.why: Amazon OA: fix each of the two alternating patterns and find the longest window with at most k mismatches.

ladder.teaches: window with a frequency map (distinct counts, anagrams)
ladder.why: Counting windows with vowel counts: for each right end, shrink to the tightest start that still holds all five vowels and count the starts before it.

ladder.teaches: window maximum with a monotonic deque
ladder.why: Recognising sliding window maximum inside a min-of-max question and folding the maxima into a running minimum.

ladder.teaches: variable window: the shortest valid (shrink while valid)
ladder.why: The hardest shortest-valid window: a need map and a missing counter make validity O(1) while left shrinks.

ladder.teaches: variable window: the longest valid (shrink while invalid)
ladder.why: Amazon OA: one segment flip clears a whole run of zeros, so the window budget counts zero-runs, not zeros.

notes: The bank has no plain Minimum Size Subarray Sum (positive values, sum >= target) and no 'Subarrays with K Different Integers'; microsoft-minimum-length-good-subarray stands in for shortest-valid and atlassian-beautiful-subarrays (exactly k odd) for exactly-k. atlassian-beautiful-subarrays was moved here from the prefix-sums pool; it can also be solved with prefix parity counts.
